rules.statement: If a debtor tells the creditor that he has come for the purpose of paying a specified amount, and the creditor says it is too late or insufficient in amount, or otherwise indicates that he will not accept the money, the actual production is thereby dispensed with, and there is a good tender of the amount mentioned by the debtor.
rules.supporting_quote: "If the debtor tells his creditor that he has come for the purpose of paying a specified amount, and the creditor says that it is too late, or is insufficient in amount, or otherwise indicates that he will not accept the money, the actual production is thereby dispensed with, and there is a good tender of the amount mentioned by the debtor"
